column1: # Keys are line-independent, so a row keeps covering its finding when the
# code around it moves. Every row needs a justification: the scanner exits
# 2 on an empty one, because an unjustified baseline row cannot be told
# This file is the pre-existing debt recorded when the scanner landed
# (issue #133) and widened (#146/#157). Nothing here is "fine"; it is
# "known, and not fixed by the change that added or widened the gate". Rows tagged stage 2 are candidates for
# docs/AUDIT_SWEEP.md's audit pass, which owns behaviour verdicts -- stage
# 1 produces a candidate list, not verdicts. Delete a row when its finding
# is fixed; the gate then keeps it fixed.
# To regenerate after a deliberate change:  scripts/audit-check.sh --update-baseline
